text: I just finished my dental work here and as always I've never been disappointed ever since I was introduced to this place and Dr. Photjana over 10 years ago.  My wife and I live in the US.  We have been treated with so many different dentists there and we have never been happy with any of them, neither with their practice ethics nor their sales tactics to trick us into unnecessary add-on services with higher charges.  To get a lousy and extremely expensive crown work in US could have paid for two to three best crowns performed by her here, with airfare included. She's so knowledgeable.  She is so willing to take her time to diagnose and patiently work on all very hard cases which we couldn't get them fixed properly in the US. She was once taught in a school of dentistry at a well-known university in the states.  Ever since, every time we visit Thailand which is every other year, we'll always make appointments ahead of time first thing first to see her to have our dental needs done before we even go enjoy the rest with our trips.  I highly recommend her. And last but not least, I strongly dispute some of the other reviews claiming that the place is not clean.  This definitely is not true. Period!
Very kind and highly experienced dentist. She speaks English, and is reasonably priced. I highly recommend this clinic to all foreigners.

I just finish my dental work here, very happy like always. Dr. Photjana and the orthodontist very kind and careful. In US, dentist too expensive and not this good. Here, much better price and high quality. Even with flight, still worth it!

I also bring my daughters for braces, and they do very good job. At first, I was shocked because I went to different clinic with same name the staff there rude and the place dirty. But this clinic very clean, with kind staff and best service. I really recommend!
Really good service with compatible prices. The doctor is very professional and helped to fix my teeth that has been bothering me for over 10 years! Really recommend!
Five Star professional dental services. The doctor solve my problem where other cannot make it done !!

You're in the right place. This is Dr. Photjana's dental practice. She's here every day and will take care of you. I came for extensive work on my teeth: two crowns and several cavities. She gave me excellent advice and did a fantastic job in record time. Everything was done in ten days. She works meticulously and efficiently. You're in highly skilled hands. The place is beautiful and clean. She speaks fluent English.
Thank you for everything, Dr. Photjana 🙏

I got my braces done here with Dr. Photjana when I was young. 20 years later, my teeth are still in perfect condition, and I love my smile! 😊 My dental health couldn't be better. The care and expertise truly made a lasting difference in my life—highly recommended!
I got my braces done here since I was a child. After treatment, my teeth are beautifully aligned.
My face shape changed too. 20 years later, I haven't had any problems! I'm very impressed. The doctor is very kind and patient, and always lets me choose pretty colors for my rubber bands, which made me not afraid of the dentist at all!

The doctor is amazing! I came for root canal treatment because of a terrible toothache and bad breath. The doctor found that the decay was so severe it had reached the nerve. After just one visit, the pain disappeared completely, and the bad breath vanished. The doctor has a very gentle touch; the anesthetic injection was painless. I highly recommend Dr. Pojana to anyone who is afraid of dental procedures. She holds a Master's degree from Sydney University, Australia, and a Ph.D. from Boston University, USA. She has taught at Mahidol University, Sydney University, Australia, and Temple University, Pennsylvania, USA – she has extensive international experience. However, her prices are very reasonable for Thai people. Dr. Pojana is incredibly skilled, kind, and has a very gentle touch… strongly recommended! 👍

My husband had all his dental work done by this dentist who speaks perfect English and saw me quickly for a check-up/cleaning. She made a diagnosis and was able to do the work immediately. She is meticulous and skilled. She works wonderfully without anesthesia, and I left an hour later with three fillings redone, which were complicated because they were deep.
If you need a dentist in Bangkok, you've come to the right place.
Thank you, Dr. Photjana! 😊😊😊

The doctor is excellent; she's a specialist in orthodontics.
My friends who went to her said it was great. After the orthodontic treatment was finished, their faces looked much slimmer and prettier.
The orthodontist is good, but the queue system is terrible. I've had to wait for a very long time many times, even though I made an appointment in advance.
